name: boundary-clamp
note: captured from a real run, and the only fixture that replays the four-coordinate swipe shape. mapActionCoordinates maps a swipe point by point (mapPoint on from and on to) and keeps every other field, so durationMs 300 survives. The origin maps to itself (the 0 clamp), and the last valid coordinate of 1080x2316 maps to (round(1079 / 1080 * 719), round(2315 / 2316 * 1543)) = (718, 1542) — inside 720x1544 and, again, not the last pixel (719, 1543). First pass guessed 719/1543 and the run corrected it.
